rationale.text: The page's html element carries lang="fr", but the cross-site document in its frame shows text and its html element has no language attribute. The test asks it of each web page and does not say whether a framed document is part of the page here. The custom check answers cannot_tell for such a frame (step 1); only the record supports this branch. axe's html-has-lang examines only the top-level document's html element and reports no fault, so the reason at full is cannot_tell; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.

citations.quote: Pour chaque page web, l’indication de langue par défaut vérifie-t-elle une de ces conditions
L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée pour l’élément `html`
